description: Minimal-pair negation probe. Each item gives a claim and one passage; the task is whether the passage supports the claim. The supporting and refuting passages in a pair differ by one word or short phrase, so their lexical overlap with the claim is effectively identical and any bag-of-words method is pinned at chance by construction. Written for this repo (issue #5); not drawn from NevIR or any public corpus, so training contamination is not a concern.
baseline_note: The word-overlap baseline scores ~50% here by design. That is the point: unlike lab/rerank.json, this task cannot be solved lexically.

pairs.claim: Beta blockers lower resting heart rate.
pairs.supports: In the trial, patients taking beta blockers showed a reduced resting heart rate compared with the placebo group.
pairs.refutes: In the trial, patients taking beta blockers showed no reduced resting heart rate compared with the placebo group.

pairs.supports: The committee voted to extend the filing deadline by two weeks.
pairs.refutes: The committee voted against extending the filing deadline by two weeks.

pairs.supports: Adding an index on the created_at column made the report query noticeably faster.
pairs.refutes: Adding an index on the created_at column made the report query noticeably slower.

pairs.supports: Regulators cleared the merger after a nine-month review.
pairs.refutes: Regulators blocked the merger after a nine-month review.

pairs.claim: Sourdough starter needs daily feeding at room temperature.
pairs.supports: A starter kept at room temperature must be fed every day to stay active.
pairs.refutes: A starter kept at room temperature need not be fed every day to stay active.

pairs.claim: The defendant was present at the scene.
pairs.supports: Three witnesses placed the defendant at the scene on the night in question.
pairs.refutes: Three witnesses placed the defendant away from the scene on the night in question.

pairs.supports: Revenue for the quarter rose 12% against the same quarter last year.
pairs.refutes: Revenue for the quarter fell 12% against the same quarter last year.

pairs.supports: Hospitalisation rates among vaccinated participants were lower than among unvaccinated participants.
pairs.refutes: Hospitalisation rates among vaccinated participants were higher than among unvaccinated participants.

pairs.claim: Python's GIL prevents true thread parallelism for CPU-bound work.
pairs.supports: Because of the global interpreter lock, CPU-bound Python threads cannot execute bytecode simultaneously.
pairs.refutes: Despite the global interpreter lock, CPU-bound Python threads can execute bytecode simultaneously.

pairs.claim: The species is native to the island.
pairs.supports: Genetic analysis confirms the population originated on the island itself.
pairs.refutes: Genetic analysis confirms the population was introduced to the island from elsewhere.

pairs.supports: The rule covers transactions completed before its effective date.
pairs.refutes: The rule covers only transactions completed after its effective date.

pairs.supports: After the cache layer was added, median page load time dropped from 1.8s to 0.4s.
pairs.refutes: After the cache layer was added, median page load time climbed from 0.4s to 1.8s.

pairs.claim: The treaty is still in force.
pairs.supports: Both parties have continued to observe the treaty since its signing.
pairs.refutes: Both parties have ceased to observe the treaty since its signing.

pairs.claim: Salt raises the boiling point of water.
pairs.supports: Dissolving salt in water raises the temperature at which it boils.
pairs.refutes: Dissolving salt in water lowers the temperature at which it boils.

pairs.claim: The bridge is open to traffic.
pairs.supports: Following repairs, the bridge reopened to vehicles on Monday.
pairs.refutes: Pending repairs, the bridge remains closed to vehicles since Monday.

pairs.supports: All public methods acquire the internal lock, so concurrent callers are safe.
pairs.refutes: No public methods acquire the internal lock, so concurrent callers are unsafe.

pairs.supports: The central bank lowered its benchmark rate by 25 basis points.
pairs.refutes: The central bank raised its benchmark rate by 25 basis points.

pairs.supports: An independent lab reproduced the original effect at a similar magnitude.
pairs.refutes: An independent lab failed to reproduce the original effect at any magnitude.

pairs.claim: Employees must give notice before resigning.
pairs.supports: The contract requires four weeks' written notice prior to departure.
pairs.refutes: The contract waives any requirement of written notice prior to departure.

pairs.supports: The compound is readily soluble in water at room temperature.
pairs.refutes: The compound is essentially insoluble in water at room temperature.

pairs.claim: Remote work increased productivity at this firm.
pairs.supports: Output per employee rose after the firm moved to remote work.
pairs.refutes: Output per employee declined after the firm moved to remote work.

pairs.claim: The API version is backward compatible.
pairs.supports: Clients written against v1 continue to work unchanged against v2.
pairs.refutes: Clients written against v1 stop working unless rewritten against v2.

pairs.supports: Pigment analysis dates the work to the artist's own lifetime.
pairs.refutes: Pigment analysis dates the work to well after the artist's lifetime.

pairs.supports: Patients should avoid grapefruit, which alters the drug's metabolism.
pairs.refutes: Patients may consume grapefruit, which does not alter the drug's metabolism.

pairs.supports: Census figures show the city gained residents over the past decade.
pairs.refutes: Census figures show the city lost residents over the past decade.

pairs.claim: TLS 1.3 removed support for RSA key exchange.
pairs.supports: TLS 1.3 dropped static RSA key exchange in favour of forward-secret modes.
pairs.refutes: TLS 1.3 retained static RSA key exchange alongside forward-secret modes.

pairs.claim: The tenant is responsible for repairs.
pairs.supports: Under the lease, the tenant bears the cost of interior repairs.
pairs.refutes: Under the lease, the landlord bears the cost of interior repairs.

pairs.claim: The eclipse was visible from the capital.
pairs.supports: Observers in the capital saw the eclipse in full.
pairs.refutes: Observers in the capital missed the eclipse entirely.

pairs.claim: The algorithm runs in linear time.
pairs.supports: Each element is visited once, giving runtime proportional to input size.
pairs.refutes: Each element is visited once per element, giving runtime proportional to input size squared.

pairs.supports: The firm reported net income of $4M for the year.
pairs.refutes: The firm reported a net loss of $4M for the year.

pairs.claim: Exercise reduced symptoms in this study.
pairs.supports: Participants assigned to the exercise arm reported fewer symptoms at week 12.
pairs.refutes: Participants assigned to the exercise arm reported more symptoms at week 12.

pairs.supports: The container specification includes an optional compressed payload block.
pairs.refutes: The container specification excludes any compressed payload block.

pairs.supports: The motion carried with 58 in favour and 42 against.
pairs.refutes: The motion failed with 42 in favour and 58 against.

pairs.supports: Survey data show the glacier's terminus has moved upvalley since 2010.
pairs.refutes: Survey data show the glacier's terminus has moved downvalley since 2010.

pairs.supports: Sign-in is blocked until a second factor is verified.
pairs.refutes: Sign-in proceeds even when no second factor is verified.

pairs.supports: The preface is signed by the author herself.
pairs.refutes: The preface is signed by the translator rather than the author.

pairs.supports: The reaction releases heat to its surroundings.
pairs.refutes: The reaction absorbs heat from its surroundings.

pairs.supports: Protection lapsed in 2021 and the invention is now in the public domain.
pairs.refutes: Protection runs to 2031 and the invention is not yet in the public domain.

pairs.supports: The script ships with a down step that restores the prior schema.
pairs.refutes: The script ships without a down step, so the prior schema cannot be restored.

pairs.supports: The witness appeared in the courtroom to give evidence.
pairs.refutes: The witness submitted a written statement instead of appearing in the courtroom.
